entities.summary: Cameron Jarrod Fleming is an American professional football offensive tackle. He was selected by the New England Patriots in the fourth round of the 2014 NFL draft. He played college football for the Stanford Cardinal. Fleming has also had stints with the Dallas Cowboys, New York Giants, and Denver Broncos.
